description: Verify that TCP sends an ACK in response to a FIN received in ESTABLISHED state (RFC 793 §3.2 p23 Terminology)
approach:
[Objective]
Receiving a FIN in ESTABLISHED moves the connection to CLOSE-WAIT — but RFC 793 also requires a corresponding ACK so the peer knows its FIN was received.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake → ESTABLISHED.
2. Tester → DUT: FIN.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: ACK   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted ACK to the FIN observed within the listen window.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout — no DUT ACK to tester FIN within listen window

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT ACK to tester FIN within listen window
